name: Kenji
bio: Fresh out of basic with hair no regulation can tame. Swears this is his serious face.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model (Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch): a textured GLB standing with its arms down (not a T-pose), not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from landmarks. A young soldier with spiky black hair in khaki fatigues, a plate carrier and knee pads.
